_comment: AC 4e extension sample set for klt yield, measurement startup_margin_lower, mismatch instrument, seed 245, N=4200 (issue #244). The first mismatch draw (seed 244, N=400, yield-samples-mismatch-startup_margin_lower.json) graded sample_size.verdict `insufficient`; the plan extends with a new seed, never argues around. Same decision rung RREF 71k and estimator as the first draw (evidence-r6-ladder-ext245-mismatch/report.json; I_nom from the companion nominal-body request evidence-r6-ladder-ext245-nommis-mismatch/report.json, seed 245 + seed_scope shared makes sample k the same die in both). A die sustaining the rung reports its measured I_nom/I_tail; a die that fails it reports the floor 1.0 (measured to sustain at nominal tail). The reported yield is a conservative LOWER bound on the true yield at the 3.0 floor. Oscillation criterion: t_cross_1 and t_cross_11 present AND vdiff peak-to-peak over 15-20 ns >= 0.1 V. Vctrl 1.65 V, the pilot ladder's convention.

negative_control.description: Known-bad variant: campaign body with RTE 2k -> 4.4k (tail starved) run at the SAME decision rung, N=100, seed 244, seed_scope shared (the control is a discriminability self-check, not a sizing claim, so it is not re-drawn with the extension seed). It must fail the rung (margin floor 1.0) where the campaign sustains it; a control unit that sustained the rung aborts the assembly instead of grading.
